list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: The e2e-test zone (test readings of tools/e2e_check) is never listed.
list.query: SELECT id FROM zones WHERE id <> 'e2e-test' ORDER BY id;

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.description: Devices of the selected zones. Devices of the e2e-test zone are never listed.
list.query: SELECT id FROM devices WHERE zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' ORDER BY id;

list.name: baseline_liters
list.label: Baseline (L per irrigation)
list.description: Liters a fixed schedule would have used per irrigation cycle. Used by the water savings panel to estimate the water saved by each rain-skipped decision. Placeholder until a baseline is stored in the database; change it in Dashboard settings -> Variables.

panels.title: Soil moisture (%)
panels.description: Calibrated soil_moisture (%) per zone, 5 min averages. Zones whose sensors are not calibrated have no data here: see the raw (ADC) panel.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 5m), zone_id AS metric, avg(soil_moisture) AS value FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND device_id IN ($device) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Soil moisture raw (ADC)
panels.description: Raw soil_moisture_raw ADC value (0-100) per zone, 5 min averages. Not comparable between sensors until they are calibrated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 5m), zone_id AS metric, avg(soil_moisture_raw) AS value FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND device_id IN ($device) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, 5m), avg(air_temp) AS "Air Temp (°C)", avg(air_humidity) AS "Air Humidity (%)", avg(light) AS "Light (%)" FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND device_id IN ($device) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Device status
panels.description: Every registered device of the selected zones with its last reading. Age is red when the last reading is older than 15 minutes (3 reading intervals of 5 min), or 'never' when the device has not sent any reading yet; green otherwise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.id AS "Device", d.zone_id AS "Zone", r.ts AS "Last reading", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - r.ts)) AS "Age" FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts FROM readings WHERE device_id = d.id AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true WHERE d.zone_id IN ($zone) AND d.zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND d.id IN ($device) ORDER BY d.id;

panels.title: Water savings (rain-skipped decisions)
panels.description: Counts 'do not irrigate' decisions caused by rain (irrigate = false AND reason ILIKE '%rain%') and estimates the liters saved as count x $baseline_liters (dashboard variable, default 4.5 L per cycle). The rain filter depends on the format of decisions.reason, which the decision service has not fixed yet: update it once that format is agreed. Replace the variable once a baseline schedule is stored in the database.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Skipped (rain)", round(count(*) * '${baseline_liters}'::numeric, 1) AS "Est. Saved (L)" FROM decisions WHERE $__timeFilter(decided_at) AND zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND irrigate = false AND reason ILIKE '%rain%';

panels.title: Daily irrigation (liters & minutes)
panels.description: What was actually irrigated: irrigation_finished events reported by the devices of the selected zones (rejected or never executed commands are not counted). Minutes = sum of the reported duration_s / 60. Liters = water_l of the decision that sent each finished command (planned liters, not measured). Days in UTC.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', e.ts) AS "Day", round(sum(COALESCE(d.water_l, 0)), 1) AS "Liters", round(sum(COALESCE(e.duration_s, 0)) / 60.0, 1) AS "Minutes" FROM irrigation_events e JOIN devices dev ON dev.id = e.device_id LEFT JOIN decisions d ON d.command_id = e.command_id WHERE e.type = 'irrigation_finished' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND dev.zone_id IN ($zone) AND dev.zone_id <> 'e2e-test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT decided_at AS "Time", zone_id AS "Zone", irrigate AS "Irrigate", duration_s AS "Duration (s)", water_l AS "Water (L)", reason AS "Reason" FROM decisions WHERE $__timeFilter(decided_at) AND zone_id IN ($zone) AND zone_id <> 'e2e-test' ORDER BY decided_at DESC;

panels.title: Irrigation events
panels.description: Device-reported events: irrigation_started, irrigation_finished, command_rejected. Filtered by the zone of the reporting device and by device.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.ts AS "Time", e.device_id AS "Device", dev.zone_id AS "Zone", e.type AS "Event", e.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", e.reason AS "Reason" FROM irrigation_events e JOIN devices dev ON dev.id = e.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND dev.zone_id IN ($zone) AND dev.zone_id <> 'e2e-test' AND e.device_id IN ($device) ORDER BY e.ts DESC;
